greeting: Coral on comms. Stage 3: The Corrupted Council. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Depths of Mystery. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I once negotiated with a door for twenty minutes. Door won on technicalities.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Infiltrate the Council Spire.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Infiltrate the Council Spire; Use Truth to reveal the corruption; Free the Council from Void control. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Confront the Void-touched High Tide Council. Immediate move: Infiltrate the Council Spire.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 3 resolved: The Corrupted Council. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Deep Walker.
rumor: Divers found a gate marked with the same sigil as the palace engine.
People keep repeating one clue from The Corrupted Council: 'Free the Council from Void control'.
A map sneezed in my pocket and revealed a hidden staircase. True story.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn tide is calm enough for precision dives. Best window for route checks.
dialog.time_noon: Noon currents fight each other in the trench. Anchor and communicate.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk visibility drops fast underwater. Stay on beacon chain.
dialog.time_night: Night tide carries deep-song interference. Confirm orders twice.

party_reactions.kade: Coral sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Coral accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Coral talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: No speeches. Give me actionable details.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You made it back. Report status.
relationship_dialog.friend: With you here, the odds stop looking stupid.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Same plan as always: adapt, push, survive, repeat.
